home-agents.alt: Home in the Grounded web app: the team's agents as cards, with the workspace navigation on the left.

chat-answer-with-claims.alt: A chat answer with numbered citation chips, a one-line claim summary such as "5 of 5 claims supported", and the collapsed sources below it.

chat-citation-card.alt: A citation chip's card opened in a chat answer: the claim's verdict, the claim's text and the cited passage, with "Show source below".

team-overview.alt: A team's Overview page: counts of sources, knowledge bases and agents, the Quality & spend row with evaluation scores and this month's spend.

data-source-web.alt: A web data source's Overview: pages crawled, passages indexed, repeated blocks removed and the next scheduled sync.

crawl-domains.alt: Data sources, Crawl domains tab: the team's domain requests with their status.

kb-try-it.alt: A knowledge base's Try it tab: a test question and the ranked passages retrieval returned, with their sources.

agent-build.alt: The agent editor's Build tab: Instructions, Model, Knowledge, Answering, Safety and Advanced sections, with the Try it panel beside them.

agent-share.alt: The agent editor's Share tab: the agent's links, the widget's publishable keys and the embed snippet.

agent-versions.alt: The agent's version menu in the editor header, with Version history, Compare versions and Revert draft.

agent-analytics.alt: An agent's Analytics tab: answers over time, satisfaction, no-context rate and tokens by model, with no message content.

evaluations-runs.alt: An evaluation set's Runs tab: retrieval and full-answer runs with their scores, and a chart of the score over time.

evaluations-result.alt: An evaluation result: the expected document beside what came back, with the rank it was found at.

team-evaluations.alt: The team's Evaluations page: every evaluation set with what it tests, its latest score, its trend and when it last ran.

team-members.alt: Team settings, Members tab: members with their roles, pending invites and a member marked "Managed by SSO group".

team-usage-spend.alt: Team settings, Usage & spend tab: this month's spend against the budget, and the team's limits with meters.

team-api-keys.alt: Team settings, API keys tab: personal and service keys with their scopes, restrictions, expiry and last use.

admin-overview-features.alt: Admin Overview: the platform at a glance, Needs attention, and the Features card listing each optional feature's state.

admin-teams.alt: Admin, Teams: every team with its approved classification, members and status.

admin-sso-groups.alt: Admin, SSO groups: rules mapping identity-provider groups to team roles, with the memberships each rule grants.

admin-models.alt: Admin, Models: chat, embedding, moderation and SystemOne models with their connection, maximum classification and state.

admin-embedding-migrations.alt: Admin, Embedding profiles, Migrations tab: a knowledge base moving to a new profile, with per-source progress.

admin-classifications.alt: Admin, Classifications: the levels Open, Sensitive and Restricted with their maximum audience and retention.

admin-moderation.alt: Admin, Moderation: the policy for the public audience with a threshold and action for each category.

admin-costs.alt: Admin, Costs Overview: spend over the chosen range, a daily chart by kind and the Top spenders card.

admin-parsing-ocr.alt: Admin, Parsing & OCR: OCR turned on with the Tesseract backend, languages and the Test button.

admin-retention.alt: Admin, Retention: the retention period for each kind of data, with the Dry run, Runs and Legal holds tabs.

admin-break-glass.alt: Admin, Break-glass: sessions with their team, scope, reason, status and read counts.

admin-analytics.alt: Admin, Analytics: platform totals, the daily chart and top agents and teams, without message content.
